lines.text: PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!\nThank you for saving us here at Silph!
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!\nThank you for saving us here at Silph!
Wahaha! I suppose that’s so. It wasn’t just you—\nit was that wonderful partner of yours, too!
I will never forget how you saved us in our\nmoment of peril.
I have to thank you in some way. And I’m quite\nmagnanimous, so I can give you anything.\c\nHere, maybe this will do?
You got the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Master Ball[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the president!
PRESIDENT: You can’t buy that anywhere.\nIt’s our secret prototype, the Master Ball.
It will catch any Pokémon without fail!\nTruthfully, we’ve only succeeded in making\r\njust the one.
So you should probably be quiet about using it.
PRESIDENT: Ah! Our saviors!\nThank you again for saving Silph Co. for us!
PRESIDENT: Oh! Wait for a moment! Please let\nme reward you!
SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing all of us.\c\nWe, from the president on down, are indebted\nto you for what you did.

SECRETARY: A Poké Ball that can catch any
Pokémon without fail...\c
It’s not something to be given to just any
ordinary Trainer. That’s why the president
entrusted it to you.
